text: With an elegant aesthetic, the Apian table takes an architectural design approach and has been meticulously crafted from exquisite materials.Its airiness is reminiscent of a curved and inclined metal sheet, creating a base with a bold and sharp shape that culminates in a top equipped with a patented mechanism allowing it to be extended to up to 3 metres in length.  The edge of the top echoes the shade of the base which has been detailed with coated double-sheet metal that gleams and catches the light, illuminating an area that would otherwise be left in the dark.  Apian is one of those unexpected pieces that will instantly turn around an interior design project.

short: Table with an extendable rectangular top and metal legs
text:
With its thoughtful proportions, the Apian table epitomises a design approach that sets great store by architectural stylishness and is underpinned by meticulously processed materials. Its airy aesthetic draws inspiration from the sheet metal bent into a semi-cylindrical shape and gently slanted upwards, creating a sharply defined base upon which the manually-extendable top rests (two side leaves mean that Apian can be pulled out to a length of 3 metres in total).
One delightful detail on the pedestal base is the coating on the double sheet metal which catches the light and throws it back on an area that would otherwise be in dark shadow.
Apian is one of those distinctive pieces that will instantly turn around an interior-design project.

Madame is a versatile writing desk designed to meet a variety of different requirements. Madame is a happy meeting of sleek pristine geometric lines. The perfection of an oval is its leitmotif, as can be gathered from the shape of both the top and drawer.

short: Table with an extendable rectangular top set on metal legs
text: The distinguishing feature of the extendable Stream table is undoubtedly the unusual shape of its legs. Created by means of a subtraction and sanding process, it does away with the usual need for angular, triangular, square or rectangular sections which are found on almost all these kinds of tables.  The long distance between the inner corners not only clearly indicates how much seating ease and leg room there is, but also gives it a light and dynamic silhouette.  It has an uncomplicated yet instantly recognisable design.The slender long legs hold up a versatile extendable top available in several different materials and finishes.

short: Table with an elliptical non-extending top and central base in cement
text: The challenge posed by the Seashell table was to use a new material for the base: cement. People often associate cement with “heaviness and solidity” both visually and physically, but we have re-imagined it to make it lighter and sturdy at the same time. We went for a soft sleek shape that takes its cues from the organic forms of nature, especially that of a shell with all its curves, ridges and furrows, whose structural solidity is belied by the incredibly fragility of the material it is made from. Thus, cement takes on a new aesthetic and functional meaning; the central base is an ideal solution and changes appearance according to the position you are looking from. Halfway between inspired creativity and functionality, this lightweight and sturdy table speaks to the soul. An ordinary everyday object has been transformed into a simple yet spectacular sculpture.

short: Table with a non-extending elliptical top and a base in shaped sheet metal
text:
Breeze is a non-extending table featuring a top made either from plate glass or ceramic to be set on a shaped-sheet-metal base. 
It draws inspiration from the “ellipses” of the artist Turi Simeti and is a feat of geometrics and an optical illusion in the true sense of the word: Two-dimensional elements grow in and out of each other, forming an intricate interlocking design and playing with shifting light as it bounces off their monochrome surface.

short: Table with an extendable elliptical top and central base
text:
The extendable Orbital table has always been in a league of its own in terms of pristine polish and contemporary cool; this revamped version has preserved its core identity while further enhancing its iconic stylishness. This new Orbital table stems from a quest to create a streamlined shape despite the widening of the top and an extremely light and contemporary appearance has been successfully achieved. The idea was to showcase the cutting-edge automatic extension system which, with one slick movement of the metal arms, causes two leaves to swing out from underneath the top, simultaneously positioning themselves at the right level and preserving the elegant oval shape.
Furthermore, this item can now be personalised with panels in various different materials to be placed on the frame, elevating the product even further and making it suitable for the most sophisticated setting.
Optional extra for separate purchase: cover CS4145-C
